archetypes.name: dyn-statusline-reset
archetypes.rationale: SessionStart reset coordinates Python pointer deletion, hook stdin handling, and bgjob protection.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the statusline reset integration from SessionStart payload parsing through progress_file.deactivate_run. Check that startup and clear delete only the current pointer, while resume, compact, missing sources, malformed payloads, and live bgjobs preserve active breadcrumbs. Pay close attention to fd-relative deletion and symlink refusal. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
